subject: Northwood Success Agreement & Delivery Timeline
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northwood.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@northwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Northwood Success Agreement & Delivery Timeline

Hi Alice / Samir,

Great to meet you both on Friday — thanks for the time and the helpful context about Northwood's Q3 rollout priorities. As discussed, I’ve pulled together a short Success Agreement / Mutual Action Plan to align owners, milestones, and dates so we’re all clear on commitments and dependencies.

Key objectives we agreed: reduce inference latency for portal search to <150ms P95, replace current embedding pipeline, and get a production-safe deployment into the eu-west region for the pilot.

Draft milestones I propose below (please see attached MAP spreadsheet for full task breakdown):
- Kickoff + Stakeholder alignment: 2029-06-20 — Owners: Rishi (Redwood commercial), Alice (Northwood sponsor)
- Discovery & data readiness: 2029-06-24 — 2029-07-05 — Owners: Monica (Redwood implementation), Samir (Northwood engineering)
- Integration & model tuning (staging): 2029-07-08 — 2029-08-02 — Owners: Monica + Northwood ENG
- UAT & performance verification: 2029-08-05 — 2029-08-16 — Owners: Northwood QA, Redwood SRE support
- Go‑live (pilot): 2029-08-23 — Owners: Monica (cutover), Alice (product sign-off)

Action requests:
1) Alice / Samir — please confirm the tech contact who will own the integration tasks (Samir, is that you?).
2) Review the attached MAP_v0.1 and highlight any missing dependencies by EOD 2029-06-14.
3) Monica — can you lead the technical deep-dive and prepare an integration checklist?

I’ve attached a deployment checklist and a first-pass MAP workbook. If these high-level dates look reasonable, Ben will send a calendar invite for the June 20 kickoff.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships (Commercial)
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@northwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 17:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Northwood Success Agreement & Delivery Timeline

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear note and the draft MAP. This aligns well with our internal timeline. Confirming: Samir will be the technical lead (cc’d here).

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can we shift the discovery window to include a half-day for data-compliance review? We need to confirm data retention and masking constraints before integration begins (suggest adding 2029-06-26 data-compliance checkpoint).
- We’ll need a formal SOW to route through procurement — if you can attach the SOW version we discussed, that would speed approvals.

I reviewed the MAP spreadsheet and added comments to the data-prep tab. Overall looks good.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform
Northwood Systems

Attachment: SOW_Northwood_2029.pdf (SOW - draft for procurement)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northwood.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@northwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2029 13:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Northwood Success Agreement & Delivery Timeline

Thanks Alice — adding the compliance checkpoint is sensible. I’ve updated the MAP and the checklist to include a 1‑day data-compliance review on 2029-06-26 and flagged key artifacts we’ll need from Northwood (sample events export, schema docs, retention policy statement).

Updated milestone calendar (summary):
- Kickoff: 2029-06-20 (30–45 min) — alignment, success criteria, decision owners
- Discovery: 2029-06-24 — 2029-07-05 (includes compliance checkpoint 2029-06-26)
- Integration: 2029-07-08 — 2029-08-02 (integration sprints; weekly syncs)
- UAT: 2029-08-05 — 2029-08-16
- Pilot Go‑live: 2029-08-23

Owner responsibilities (concise):
- Northwood (Samir): provide sample dataset, API access for staging, validation criteria for latency and correctness
- Northwood (Alice): executive sign-off, procurement liaison for SOW approvals
- Redwood (Monica): implementation lead — integration tasks, runbook, performance tuning
- Redwood (Rishi): commercial sponsor — contract/ops escalations

Attachments included: MAP workbook (Northwood_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) and deployment checklist (redwood_deployment_checklist_v1.pdf). I will own the integration runbook and share a first draft by 2029-06-28.

Next steps: Ben, can you please coordinate the kickoff invite and add a calendar item for a 30–45 minute meeting on 2029-06-20 at 16:00 BST / 11:00 ET? Also linking the Drive folder with the working MAP here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dNorthwoodMAP

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Client Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Northwood_MAP_v0.1.xlsx, redwood_deployment_checklist_v1.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@northwood.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@northwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2029 15:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Northwood Success Agreement & Delivery Timeline

All — calendar invite sent for 2029-06-20 11:00 ET / 16:00 BST. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=northwood-kickoff-20290620

I’ve also uploaded the SOW to DocuSign for signature to speed procurement: https://www.docusign.com/s/abc123-SOW-Northwood. Alice — when you have a sec can you confirm the procurement contact so I can route it correctly?

Quick note on risks: we flagged two gating items in the MAP — (1) access to a representative dataset for tuning, and (2) firewall/VPC peering for staging. Would appreciate Northwood raising those internally prior to discovery.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
